Based on the supplied passages, **two airworthiness directives cover part number 2013142-18**:

1. **AD 2008-10-02** – This AD directly addresses the "P/N 2013142-18 alternate static air source selector valve" (Applicability paragraph (c)(1) and Note 2).  
   *Source: AD-2008-10-02, section Applicability*

2. **AD 2008-26-10** – This AD also references P/N 2013142-18 (Note 2 and Applicability paragraph (c)(2)) and requires compliance with the modification/rework mandated by AD 2008-10-02.  
   *Source: AD-2008-26-10, section Applicability and Note 2*
